reply_text:
I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread. I treated the 8 April renewal date as unverified and didn't record it anywhere.

I couldn't check it. Nothing Pree has access to mentions Brackenwater Freight Co.: no contract, CRM entry or renewal date in the shared files, and no earlier mention in #central-team. In my reply I said the account owner should confirm the date from the contract or with the customer before anyone plans around it.

No approval was needed, because a renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
